VERDICT: REPAIR_REQUIRED. This is independent read-only static salvage, not admission. Exact subject: D:/NavSlidesQualification/edu-resume-261004/pending-substrate-candidate-09-partial. admission=false; sourceReady=false; qualification=false; passClaimed=false; runtimeExecuted=false; staticallyAdmittedCells=0; executedAcceptanceCells=0. Five concrete source findings are reported separately below. The absent genuine Native09 receipt is an additional, distinct delivery blocker, not the basis for the source verdict.

SCOPE AND AUTHORITY
The complete native salvage prompt, partial09 freeze and full-input scope-preservation records,09 terminal-failure counsel and dispatch authority,08 settled-rejection counsel and subject authority,07 original Native and Evidence admission reports,08 Native and Evidence salvage audits, and genuine09 Evidence receipt were read. All15 mapped Native helpers were read through their complete bodies, including unchanged helpers. All11 opposite-partition Evidence helpers were also read through their complete bodies to trace imported snapshot, error-ledger, normalization, exposure, surface-ownership and finalization consumers. All12 immutable Phase2 callers were read. Current production source was read only from the exact frozen09 root: runtime-session.js, browser/mount.js, browser/local-activity.js, countdown-state.js, browser/countdown-presenter.js, browser/reveal-lifecycle.js, and the configured keyboardCondition section of shared/src/htmlGenerator.js. Two narrowly selected prior08 source sections establish introduction of the missing browser-function brace and removed serializable declaration; prior reports otherwise supply obligations, not present closure. No commands, edits, file writes, git operations, nested agents, imports/module execution, runtime, tests, browser operations, builds, lint or formatting were performed.

Paths below, unless explicitly stated otherwise, are relative to tests/e2e/education in that exact frozen09 root. SOURCE-CORRECTED LOCAL means the particular prior defect is repaired in inspected source; it does not imply an executable or admitted substrate, because the separate current module-syntax and native-packet-completion defects block the normal observation/action path.

ORIGINAL FINDING DISPOSITIONS — ALL12 NATIVE, IN ORIGINAL07 ORDER
1. N06-N02: Keep Start diagnostics out of lifecycle continuity — REPAIR_REQUIRED, with the intended filtering preserved but diagnostic delivery regressed. native-history.js:47-69, __nsExtractDomainHistories, projects only root-pause/root-resume and document visibility/page events and independently copies their event objects and primitive lifecycle detail. observation-browser.js:89-98 uses matching root/document classification. Thus neither projection counts native-action diagnostics as pause/resume continuity. However, completePacket at native-history.js:107-109 references an undeclared serializable. It reaches neither __nsRecordedPackets.push nor recordFn('native-action',...), so both required diagnostic projections are lost. Restore the actual packet copy before root removal and preserve both outputs; do not remove the diagnostic to make continuity pass.
2. Declare firstExpiredSample before the witness polling callback — SOURCE-CORRECTED LOCAL. witness.js:98-100 declares it in waitForWitnessExpiry; :113-122 assigns and checks it after validateExpiredWitnessPoll; :130-146 returns the original first-expired sample, last-running sample, expiryObservationInterval, activityElapsedInterval, expiredState and expiryTime. :150-166 consumes the resulting bounds in assertMeasuredWitnessInterval. This is source evidence, not an observed expiry; the normal route is separately blocked.
3. N06-N02: Validate capture-to-post history before adopting Start — SOURCE-CORRECTED LOCAL, with the executable Start path separately REPAIR_REQUIRED. witness.js:8-15 now explicitly imports assertHistoryPrefix from witness-domain.js, which re-exports the real history-domain.js comparator at :2-7. witness.js:44-58 rejects missing capture/post histories, compares complete prefixes and equal lengths for both root and document histories, and only then constructs baselines at :59-70. native-history.js:50-69 makes separate capture/post copies, and history-domain.js:24-53 compares time, bounds, sequence, type, visibility and detail. witness.js:72-76 validates the first running state and continuity before promoting runningSample/deadline. The removed packet-copy declaration prevents executeAction from actually delivering this bracket; the repaired comparator import does not erase that new defect.
4. N06-N03: Bind history health to actual recorder bookkeeping — SOURCE-CORRECTED LOCAL. native-observation.js:24-26 retains separate public and private arrays; :47-73 verifies public array identity, counts, event type/sequence, tMin/tMax/time, visibilityState and serialized detail against private snapshots. :89-110 clones detail independently at insertion and retains complete private event content. An initialized, untouched empty store remains healthy; replacement, truncation and same-sequence content corruption reject. Consumer trace: observation-browser.js:5-17 gates passive-event return; :61-65 gates cursor health; :82-98 gates correlated projection before observation-domain.js:109-135 builds clock provenance; :148-159 gates candidate extraction. native-history.js:80-92 and :133-145 gate capture/bubble pair calculations, and :51-54 independently gates domain-history extraction before projection. No other current education helper reads __nsLifecycleEvents outside these traced paths. These are inspected gates, not executed integrity tests; the browser module itself has a new syntax defect.
5. N06-N03: Compare complete retained history content — SOURCE-CORRECTED LOCAL. history-domain.js:24-53 requires both arrays, sufficient prefix length, mandatory matching numeric eventSeq, type, tMin/tMax/time, visibilityState and serialized detail. The previously omitted event.time is included at :43-44. witness-domain.js:80-104 consumes this comparator for both histories and retains exact lengths and completed-pause count. The complete-store checker described in disposition4 protects records before a witness baseline exists and includes diagnostics and other-root detail/domain, rather than relying solely on witness prefix checks.
6. Retain lifecycle mutations drained at native action boundaries — SOURCE-CORRECTED LOCAL. native-history.js:6-7 and :31-40 retain triggerMin and later deliveryMax. __nsExtractDomainHistories at :55 includes events by tMin<=maxTime, not tMax<=maxTime. Capture and post drain pending mutations before calculating history at :79 and :114. native-snapshot.js:86-100 and history-domain.js:9-21 use the same tMin inclusion rule for pairs; activity-interval.js:23-35 derives lower and upper hidden durations from both uncertainty bounds. A drained event with deliveryMax later than the boundary is not discarded or clamped away.
7. N06-N05: Normalize and retain all observed snapshot failures — PARTIAL / REPAIR_REQUIRED. native-snapshot.js:55-78 observes state before UI. observation-errors.js:25-30 records recorder failures; :34-45 records selected packet capture-state, capture-UI, post-state, post-UI; :48-65 records direct snapshot siblings in the same order; :67-73 records the later document-validation failure and throws the earliest normalized return. error-ledger.js:44-64 and :76-103 preserve actual Node references and cache browser-envelope normalization. The common facade stages raw observations at observation.js:46,64,83,105 before dispatch. Nevertheless, when no exact packet matches, observation-errors.js:33 chooses only one cursor-eligible candidate; genuine errors in later eligible packets are never ingested before outer rejection. See the candidate-retention finding. The browser module syntax defect also prevents normal import of this facade.
8. N06-N05: Preserve the recorder exception's actual cause chain — SOURCE-CORRECTED LOCAL. native-observation.js:36-44 recursively serializes real causes with phase, stack and documentId/timeOrigin/URL; :120-122 uses that envelope for observer setup failure. error-ledger.js:44-64 recursively materializes causes, and :11-41 recursively serializes them while retaining root/document provenance. Actual Node Error identity remains unchanged. No runtime cause-chain certification is claimed.
9. N06-N01: Stage each navigation poll's actual document first — SOURCE-CORRECTED LOCAL. navigation.js:85-91 captures slideId, URL, documentId and timeOrigin together; :92-98 stages the complete raw poll and contextual record before :99-103 validates document binding. An offending wrong-document poll therefore survives validation failure in the stage trace.
10. N06-N07: Match keyboard eligibility to production dispatch — SOURCE-CORRECTED for the concrete original exclusions and configured production policy, with an explicit external-dependency limitation. navigation.js:37-69 observes input/textarea/contenteditable focus, game/action ancestry, function-valued keyboardCondition and focused-deck conditions without forcing focus or changing policy. Current browser/reveal-lifecycle.js:73-83 rejects game/action focus and delegates the prior configured condition. shared/src/htmlGenerator.js:462-466 additionally excludes summary/video/audio through that condition. The exact external Reveal keyboard-controller implementation was not found among frozen regular files by narrow filename search; the preserved dependency junction is outside the hash-frozen regular-file subject. Complete external-dispatch certification is therefore not claimed.
11. Preserve exact null commands when matching native packets — SOURCE-CORRECTED LOCAL. observation-domain.js:60-69 matches sequence, root tuple, document domain, URL, event type and exact command; :67-68 normalizes only an absent cursor command to null and rejects a packet with a non-null command. controls.js input/change paths at :44-50,:54-69,:73-79 and :144-151 use native-action.js:7-16 with the deliberate null default. The current matcher is not a wildcard.
12. Reject disconnected current nodes during action extraction — SOURCE-CORRECTED LOCAL. observation-browser.js:136-144 captures actual isConnected; observation-domain.js:41-58 rejects disconnection before complete instance/tuple/document/URL agreement; observation.js:116 invokes that agreement before packet validation and acceptance. Normal execution is separately blocked by the missing browser-function brace.

ORIGINAL EVIDENCE FINDING DISPOSITIONS — ALL3
E06-01-A, sole actual Error with secondaryFailures:[] — SOURCE-CORRECTED / PRESERVED. error-ledger.js:108-115 refreshes exposure only for multiple occurrences; produceThrow at :138-146 returns the sole actual primary without calling refreshLedgerExposure. Empty caller-owned secondary arrays are not used as proof of multiple errors, and actual Error identity is retained at :87-89.
E06-01-B, caller ledger deduplication by identity rather than numeric order — PARTIAL / REPAIR_REQUIRED. error-exposure.js:169-174 still appends by identical serialization-object absence, so unrelated caller order collisions do not suppress new records. However, new reconciliation at :95-101 replaces an occurrence's serialization object after nested recording has already exposed its original object. The caller-owned errorLedger then contains both representations of that same occurrence. See the stable-serialization finding; the old identity-deduplication repair is not fully preserved through the new reconciliation consumer.
E06-01-C, ingestion of genuine caller-errorLedger failures — PARTIAL / REPAIR_REQUIRED. error-exposure.js:7-23 pre-scans authoritative wrappers; :39-70 ingests shared actual references, and :73-105 ingests caller errorLedger failures before later arrivals. :11,:59,:76 exclude plain serialized diagnostics from allErrors/errorLedger occurrence ingestion. The simple shared-reference wrapper-metadata case is improved. Nevertheless, reconciliation reserializes via serializeError, whose error-owned phase takes precedence at error-ledger.js:15, undoing the authoritative wrapper phase when the actual Error already carries a different phase. See the wrapper-phase finding. Reconciliation also duplicates exposed serialization objects as noted for E06-01-B.

ADDITIONAL08 FINDING DISPOSITIONS — ALL4 NATIVE AND BOTH EVIDENCE SEAMS
Native08-1, unbound witness assertHistoryPrefix — SOURCE-CORRECTED LOCAL: witness.js:8-15 imports the symbol; witness-domain.js:2-7 forwards the real implementation; witness.js:51,55 consumes it. No implicit export binding is assumed.
Native08-2, incomplete private retained-store integrity and missing event.time comparison — SOURCE-CORRECTED LOCAL: native-observation.js:24-26,47-73,89-110 retains and compares complete ordered event content, including serialized detail/domain and time; all store-reading consumers are traced above. history-domain.js:43-44 now compares time explicitly. Independent full capture/post lifecycle copies remain present.
Native08-3, browser-snapshot versus later Node document-validation chronology — SOURCE-CORRECTED LOCAL for that exact defect. observation-errors.js:12-23 captures but does not record the document-identity exception immediately. Recorder and snapshot occurrences are recorded at :25-65 before documentIdentity at :67-68; recordError's normalized return is thrown at :71-73. createEvidenceAccumulator.assertDocumentIdentity at evidence.js:86-92 validates/throws without itself ingesting an occurrence, so the earlier attempted validation does not silently reorder the common ledger. Within selected packet/direct snapshots, state-before-UI and capture-before-post order is explicit.
Native08-4, candidate packet getter errors lost on outer extraction failure — PARTIAL / REPAIR_REQUIRED. observation.js:106-115 now selects/stages an exact match and passes it to the outer error consumer before node agreement; selected matched-packet siblings survive recorder/document failure. With no exact match, observation-errors.js:33 considers only the first cursor-eligible candidate, not every relevant eligible candidate in sequence order. Later candidate siblings remain raw-only and are discarded from the normalized ledger before rejection. Required repair: iterate the relevant cursor-eligible fallback packets in recorded sequence order and ingest every genuine sibling before the outer gate can throw.
Evidence08-1, serialized diagnostic promotion — SOURCE-CORRECTED: error-exposure.js:11,59,76 restrict caller allErrors/errorLedger references to actual Error instances or actual nested Error references. A wrapper containing only {name,message} is preserved in its caller array without recordErrorFn ingestion; the materializeEnvelope consumer is therefore not invoked for that diagnostic.
Evidence08-2, lost authoritative wrapper phase/metadata on shared Error reference — PARTIAL / REPAIR_REQUIRED. extractWrapper at error-exposure.js:7-23 resolves wrapper information before secondary ingestion, and :86-101 reconciles an existing actual-reference entry without adding a new occurrence. But reserialization at :101 again prefers normalized.phase over existing.phase through error-ledger.js:15. A wrapper phase of 'close' over an actual Error phase of 'previous' leaves getSerializedErrors with 'previous', contrary to authoritative wrapper precedence. The new serialization-object replacement also creates duplicate caller exposures. FrameUrl sidecar itself is forwarded; the finding is not a claim that the simple metadata-only case remains unchanged from08.

PRESERVATION DISPOSITIONS
Start diagnostic retention — NOT PRESERVED end-to-end: both intended __nsRecordedPackets and native-action store outputs are blocked by the undeclared serializable at native-history.js:107-109. Lifecycle-only root/document projection classification and independent capture/post copies are preserved locally at :47-69 and observation-browser.js:89-98.

Recursive actual causes and error identity — PRESERVED LOCALLY: native-observation.js:36-44,120-122; native-snapshot.js:23-51; error-ledger.js:11-64,76-103 preserve real recursive cause/domain/stack data, normalized browser-envelope identity and original Node Error references. N06-N04 finite timing — PRESERVED LOCALLY: witness-domain.js:40-46,118-125 checks initial and polled remainingMs as finite, positive and <=4000; clock.js:46-59 rejects nonfinite due/remaining values and requires a positive remaining interval; activity-interval.js:3-16,46-65 validates ordered finite interval operands instead of fabricating slack. Actual clock alignment is consistent with runtime-session.js:23-25,104-118 and mount.js:114-126 pause/resume ordering.

N06-N08 subject meanings — PRESERVED by the fully read authorities and current receipt mappings: NC11 remains exact temporal-evidence staging; RPC17 retains its original unresolved meaning; original9 remains full Trivia scoring. Both historical mapping snapshots retain their identities. Original7 Hot Potato exact speed bonus, original8 Scatter NFC duplicate/unique scoring and original9 full Trivia scoring matrix remain UNCHANGED_REQUIRED_OTHER_SLICE, not renamed, deleted or qualified by this salvage.
E06-02 arrival dispatch — PRESERVED LOCALLY: release-portable-inspection.js:20-33 records each actual frame rejection in its catch before the next frame iteration; release-surfaces.js:78-82 forwards pageerror at arrival. The newly reported wrapper-phase and exposure-identity defects are separate from this preserved Error-reference property.
E06-04 state-before-UI observation — PRESERVED LOCALLY: native-snapshot.js:55-78 invokes state before UI; live-root-observation.js:119-123 emits stateError before uiError. Selected native packet siblings retain capture-before-post/state-before-UI dispatch at observation-errors.js:34-65. This does not excuse the omitted fallback candidates.
E06-05 normalized provenance — PRESERVED LOCALLY: error-ledger.js:11-64,76-103 preserves recursive cause, rootInstanceId and timeOrigin; evidence.js:166-179 retains primary root/document provenance; the common native error consumer throws the normalized recordError return. Frame sidecar and actual Node references are retained.
Surface ownership/finalization — PRESERVED LOCALLY: surfaces.js validates its mandatory sink, installs context init scripts before Present/share document creation, binds actual document identities and supplies the real page-containing callback context. Its file branch at :130-136 stashes the actual early portable handle before navigation; :166-188 retains post-inspection, live collection and close ownership. release-surfaces.js:29-34 supports no-sink use and :98-141 preserves actual handle transfer and no-callback navigation-failure cleanup. evidence.js:139-196 retains source GET/comparison, measured attachment failure ingestion and final common-ledger throw. The genuine Native09 delivery receipt is absent. The governing terminal-failure counsel records Native09 transport stream_error/exit1 without complete producer delivery; this review did not rerun or reconstruct that terminal result and did not manufacture a receipt. The genuine Evidence09 receipt exists and was read completely, but its presence and closure assertions do not substitute for independent source review or missing Native delivery. Exactly-one09 substantive authority is exhausted: no retry, new producer, receipt-only continuation, repair or runtime progression is authorized by this salvage. Both source repairs and genuine producer completion require later explicit authority; no further verification is recommended under the current09 authorization.

findings.body: evaluateActionCandidates opens at line129 but is never closed after its root.evaluate call at line161. Consequently the following export declaration is inside that unfinished function body, where ES-module export syntax is illegal; the final brace closes evaluateDocumentActivity, not the outer function. observation.js imports this module at lines12-18, so its complete observation facade and the controls/clock/witness/surface import graph cannot load. The prior08 source has the missing closing brace between these functions. Restore that function boundary before the next export. This is static source evidence only; no import or syntax check was executed.
findings.title: Close evaluateActionCandidates before the next export

findings.body: completePacket now deletes serializable.root and forwards serializable to both packet storage and the native-action recorder, but the complete module/script contains no declaration of serializable. The prior08 implementation created it with Object.assign({}, packet) immediately before this deletion. On the native bubbling completion path, this reference throws before either output is written; completedEvents has already been marked, so the subsequent document bubble handler does not recover the packet. Even after the independent browser-module syntax repair, executeAction/extractActionBracket receives no completed action evidence, and valid Start/Reset/input journeys cannot return their brackets. Restore the actual packet copy before removing its DOM root and retain both __nsRecordedPackets and lifecycle diagnostic outputs.
findings.title: Restore the serializable packet copy before publishing native actions

findings.body: When extractActionBracket finds no exact matching packet, its outer error dispatch passes a null matchedPacket and this fallback selects only the first candidate with sequence greater than the cursor. evaluateActionCandidates retains all such candidates, but no later eligible packet is inspected here. Therefore a genuine stateBeforeError/uiBeforeError/stateAfterError/uiAfterError in a later relevant candidate remains only in the staged raw result: an independent recorder/document failure throws from this helper, or the subsequent no-match branch throws, before those occurrences reach the common normalized ledger. Process the relevant cursor-eligible fallback candidates in recorded sequence order, retaining each packet's state-before-UI/capture-before-post siblings before outer rejection; retain exact-match selection for normal bracket acceptance.
findings.title: Retain errors from every relevant fallback candidate before rejection

findings.body: For an actual primary Error with secondaryFailures=[closeError] and caller-owned errorLedger=[{error:closeError,phase:'close',metadata:{frameUrl:'file:///child.html'}}], the wrapper pre-scan correctly supplies metadata during nested closeError recording. That nested record invokes refreshLedgerExposure from error-ledger.js:108-115 and appends closeError's serialized object to the caller array. When outer ingestion reaches the same wrapper, metadata makes updated true and this assignment replaces existing.serialized with a different object. refreshLedgerExposure at lines169-174 then appends that new identity as well, leaving two ledger-created serialized records for the same order/occurrence in the caller-owned errorLedger. Reconcile fields without replacing an already-exposed serialization identity, or otherwise track and update the owned exposure without duplicating it or replacing caller objects.
findings.title: Preserve serialization identity while reconciling caller wrappers

findings.body: If a genuine shared Error already carries phase='previous' and its caller errorLedger wrapper authoritatively specifies phase='close', this reconciliation sets existing.phase and existing.serialized.phase to 'close', but then immediately reserializes the normalized Error. serializeError in error-ledger.js:15 uses err.phase || phase, so the replacement serialization again exposes 'previous' rather than the authoritative wrapper phase. getSerializedErrors consequently reports the wrong phase despite the wrapper being retained and the entry phase being corrected. Apply the wrapper's resolved phase to the serialization without allowing the Error-owned phase to override it, while preserving the original Error object and occurrence identity.
findings.title: Keep authoritative wrapper phase when reserializing shared errors
